text: Hello, I'm so sorry to message this late and I really hope I'm not wasting anyone's time. I'm a childminder and I've got an 11 year old boy staying over tonight while his parents are away, they've said I can call about anything medical. He's been a bit under the weather since yesterday and I took his temperature about twenty minutes ago and it was 38.3. He's got very dark skin so honestly I wouldn't have spotted anything on his arms or chest, but I'd read that you should look at the lighter bits, so I checked the palms of his hands and the soles of his feet and inside his bottom eyelids. On his palms and soles there are these tiny purplish-red dots, like someone's flicked a pen at him, and there's a couple of darker blotchy marks that look a bit like bruises on one foot. I pressed the side of a glass on them like the leaflets say and they're still there, they didn't go pale at all, I did it twice to be sure. I've rung his mum but it went to voicemail. I'm sorry if this is nothing, I just didn't feel right leaving it until the morning without asking someone who knows.
